stem:
Meera stands in front of a large plane mirror fixed on the wall of her living room. She walks slowly towards the mirror.
As she gets closer to the mirror, what happens to her image?

options.text: the image moves farther away from the mirror
the image stays at the same distance from the mirror
the image first moves closer and then stops at the mirror surface
the image moves closer to the mirror

teacher.key_rationale: In a plane mirror, image distance behind the mirror equals object distance in front of it. As Meera walks closer, her image distance decreases by the same amount, so the image moves closer to the mirror. A reverses the relationship, B ignores the change, and C adds a stopping condition that the rule does not contain.
